expected_result.method_head: empty or exactly one typed row; absence, expiry, revoked state or uncorrelated receipt is a readiness blocker, never approval
expected_result.bg1_proof: empty or exactly one typed row; not fresh_complete means no activation readiness
expected_result.source_metadata: missing retained response or missing fresh batch is reported as unavailable, never fabricated or retried
expected_result.hashes_and_columns: review exact returned metadata against immutable repo implementation before any later writer is prepared

stop_conditions: SHA-256 mismatch for manifest-approved file before execution
Target is not qscbgcdmivbbnzrcyegn or would require new login/2FA
SQL error, unknown shape, missing required relation or function, unexpected data type
Different native pinned function or installed parent baseline
Before-data catalog admission fails for a base table or exact built-in column shape
Actual recent source join exceeds nine rows or duplicate stored HTTP response exists
Unexpected source identity, duplicate method/proof row, excessive counts or response/output bounds
STOP_OUTPUT_CAP, ambiguous reply, transaction or wall-clock limit
An already installed qualification successor or unreviewed dependency requires a newly bound package
failure_handling: STOP; no retry or diagnosis; if a transaction remains open issue only a full ROLLBACK; do not count an unclear reply as success

allowed_now_after_go: Record the exact three-source CH→AT visa scope decision
Execute the single bound read-only file once
Evaluate and prepare a separate tested successor package

checks: JSON parses; three exact source hashes
File UTF-8 byte lengths and SHA-256
Exactly one READ ONLY transaction and terminal ROLLBACK
No DML/DDL/COMMIT, sequence allocation, project function invocation or source call in SQL
Catalog shape gate precedes first project-table data access; no raw GUC/default/constraint/trigger expression output
Actual source join and response uniqueness checked before payload
Explicit one-row method/BG1 LIMIT-2 gates and closed unique three-source lists before result construction

baseline_order_rule: This read changes no baseline. A later AT or CH→DE write must bind the actual predecessor left by the other package; no blind reseal and no implicit cross-package Go.
manifest_self_hash: Not embedded. Compute SHA-256 over these exact bytes and quote outside manifest-bound files.

catalog_admission.allowed_relation_kind: ordinary base table only; no inheritance
catalog_admission.allowed_column_types: exact built-in pg_catalog types, no custom/domain/array/typmod variation
catalog_admission.actual_source_join_gate: bounded 10-row precursor; >9, foreign source or duplicate batch/source aborts before payload
catalog_admission.fixed_source_list_gate: Both three-row lists must contain the exact three allowed source IDs once each; otherwise abort before payload
catalog_admission.one_row_output_gates: Method head and identical fully correlated BG1 join each checked with LIMIT 2; >1 aborts before payload, zero remains a missing proof
